fastfetch.name: Ryoku Dossier
fastfetch.author: Ryoku Team
fastfetch.summary: Editorial system dossier
fastfetch.description: A structured Ryoku readout with grouped vitals, system, and session sections in vermillion and warm paper tones.

fastfetch.name: Minimal Grid
fastfetch.author: Ryoku Team
fastfetch.summary: Compact terminal inventory
fastfetch.description: A quiet, logo-free grid that keeps the essential machine facts legible in narrow terminal panes.

fastfetch.name: Spectrum
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Tri-colour sectioned system readout
fastfetch.description: The distro logo beside VITALS, SYSTEM and hardware blocks, each key inked in its own blue, magenta or yellow with Nerd Font glyphs.

fastfetch.name: System Console
fastfetch.author: MiZentUi
fastfetch.summary: Boxed multi-panel dashboard
fastfetch.description: A dense dashboard grouping System, Terminal, Hardware and Media into framed tables beside a compact Arch mark.

fastfetch.name: Arc Reactor
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Industrial HUD readout with magenta labels
fastfetch.description: A two-column heads-up display: the Arch logo beside magenta section labels with Nerd Font icons, red divider rules and a green ONLINE/THREATS status line. Shows OS, kernel, uptime, CPU, GPU, memory, disk, shell, WM, terminal and battery.

fastfetch.name: Block Banner
fastfetch.author: kuruma-config
fastfetch.summary: ARCH block banner over a green/blue labeled card
fastfetch.description: A large ANSI-Shadow ARCH block-letter banner sits above a closed rounded label card. The card lists OS, kernel, packages and shell, a blue DE/WM group, and a green hardware group (host, CPU, GPU, disk, memory, swap, uptime, display). Green primary accent with a blue secondary band on a near-black surface.

fastfetch.name: Bulkhead
fastfetch.author: Cmdr_Scotty
fastfetch.summary: Yellow-framed hardware and software tree
fastfetch.description: A three-section readout - Hardware, Software, Miscellaneous - drawn as a branch tree inside a yellow box frame beside the Arch logo. Keys are red for hardware, green for software, blue for the desktop and magenta for the misc block over the terminal palette.

fastfetch.name: Cassette
fastfetch.author: esplatanukis2-wq
fastfetch.summary: Twin-box readout with a rainbow mini-box column
fastfetch.description: A twin-box layout: a narrow mini-box column (magenta, green, blue, yellow and red with Nerd Font tree icons) beside a wide framed panel of values covering title, system, hardware and a cassette now-playing line.

fastfetch.name: Control Room
fastfetch.author: rorfetch
fastfetch.summary: Four-panel boxed system dashboard with dotted rails
fastfetch.description: A closed box divided into SYSTEM, DESKTOP, RESOURCES and SOFTWARE panels, every row padded with a dotted rail to one shared right border. Uses a 256-colour scheme: a dark-red frame, green/cyan/yellow/purple section accents, green-on-grey usage bars, and a red skull gradient beneath.

fastfetch.name: Day Brief
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Datetime header over a colour-coded system rundown
fastfetch.description: A datetime header followed by colour-coded sections (blue system, yellow hardware, cyan disk, green software, white network, red audio); every key is an icon plus an English label at a fixed 20-column width, set beside a small Arch logo.

fastfetch.name: Deep Specs
fastfetch.author: ghosttree
fastfetch.summary: Arrow tree with detailed CPU, GPU and monitor rows
fastfetch.description: An arrow-separated three-section tree - system (red), desktop (green), hardware (yellow) - with Nerd Font branch keys. The hardware block carries a detailed CPU row (cores and clock) plus per-GPU, host, memory, disk and monitor rows over a near-black background.

fastfetch.name: Dog Tag
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Military stencil readout, gold keys and red gauges
fastfetch.description: A compact readout beside the small Arch mark with gold keys, a ' ~> ' separator rail and red percentage gauges on RAM and storage. Shows OS, shell, CPU, dual GPUs, memory, storage, now-playing media and a colour row.

fastfetch.name: Dual Panel
fastfetch.author: kuruma-config
fastfetch.summary: Magenta System and cyan Hardware panels with arrows
fastfetch.description: Two open panels stacked beside a small Arch logo: a magenta System panel (user, OS, kernel, uptime, WM, shell) above a cyan Hardware panel (CPU, GPU, RAM, display, battery). Each row is an aligned label column ending in a divider and an arrow readout. Magenta primary accent, cyan secondary, on a near-black surface.

fastfetch.name: Full Audit
fastfetch.author: LainOS
fastfetch.summary: Tree-bracketed system, software and hardware audit
fastfetch.description: Three tree-bracketed sections - system (magenta), software (green) and hardware (yellow) - with box-drawing keys and Nerd Font icons, closed by a two-tone ANSI palette bar. The hardware block is an inventory of host, CPU, GPU, display, memory, swap and uptime.

fastfetch.name: Full Frame
fastfetch.author: sofijacom
fastfetch.summary: Wide grey box framing blue-dot system lines
fastfetch.description: A single wide grey frame wraps the readout beside a blue-tinted Arch logo, each line marked with a uniform blue dot and a triangle separator. Three stacked panels group software, hardware and session info, closing with a circle color bar.

fastfetch.name: Grimoire
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Rounded monochrome card, right-aligned values
fastfetch.description: A rounded card beside the Arch mark with left-hand labels and right-aligned values. Shows OS, kernel, uptime, shell, WM, RAM, CPU, disk, packages and owner, closed by a centred banner line.

fastfetch.name: Install Log
fastfetch.author: harilvfs
fastfetch.summary: Nerd Font icon list with cyan keys and swatch footer
fastfetch.description: An icon-led key/value list where every row is keyed by a Nerd Font glyph: OS, kernel, packages, shell, terminal, WM, display, CPU/GPU, memory, swap, disk and uptime, ending in an eight-dot ANSI palette bar. Cyan keys on a near-black background.

fastfetch.name: Key Cards
fastfetch.author: Beastboy999cr
fastfetch.summary: Twin rounded red panels beside the Arch logo
fastfetch.description: Two rounded box panels in red sit to the right of the Arch logo, the first listing identity and the second hardware, with green accents on the display and uptime rows. Keys, borders and icons share one red accent while values use the terminal foreground.

fastfetch.name: Pastel Brief
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Airy Catppuccin readout with pastel nerd-font keys
fastfetch.description: A short, spacious readout beside a small Arch mark. OS, CPU, board, memory and disk rows carry pastel Catppuccin key icons, a coloured user@host title, and a trailing row of colour dots.

fastfetch.name: Pill Box
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Boxed Nerd Font label column, straw-yellow icons
fastfetch.description: A boxed pill column of Nerd Font labels with values trailing to the right. Straw-yellow icons with cyan and magenta section heads across system, hardware, storage, media, date and palette rows.

fastfetch.name: Pit Wall
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: F1 pit-wall telemetry with navy bars and dot leaders
fastfetch.description: A telemetry board with a boxed header, navy bar markers on every line, yellow and red field labels, dotted leaders and white values. Sections cover team/chassis, powertrain (CPU, GPU, memory, disk, battery), session data and a now-playing radio line.

fastfetch.name: Plain Column
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Clean no-icon key/value list with palette swatch footer
fastfetch.description: A plain single-column key/value readout with no key icons: title, OS, host, kernel, uptime, packages, shell, resolution, desktop/theming, terminal, CPU/GPU and memory, closed by the 16-colour palette swatch. Blue keys on a near-black background.

fastfetch.name: Pocket Card
fastfetch.author: kuruma-config
fastfetch.summary: Compact blue card headed with the hostname
fastfetch.description: A small blue card beside a compact Arch logo, headed by a hostname bar and listing OS, user, kernel, uptime, packages and memory with lowercase labels. Each row is an aligned label column plus its value. Blue primary accent on a near-black surface.

fastfetch.name: Service Manual
fastfetch.author: awesome-fastfetch-collection
fastfetch.summary: Red double-ruled diagnostics table with a left wall
fastfetch.description: A dense, service-manual style readout framed by red double-line rules with aligned top/cross/bottom junctions and a left wall. Sections for identity, time, software, hardware, storage and power/net each sit under a ruled divider, every row keyed by a coloured Nerd Font icon and a red column bar.

fastfetch.name: Soft Column
fastfetch.author: aayushchalise
fastfetch.summary: Titled icon list framed by ANSI palette swatch bars
fastfetch.description: A titled Nerd Font key/value list wrapped top and bottom by eight-dot ANSI palette bars, using a single-space separator and mauve keys. Shows OS, kernel, packages, shell, terminal, WM, display, CPU/GPU, memory, swap, disk and uptime over a near-black background.

fastfetch.name: Terminal Online
fastfetch.author: kitty-cachyos
fastfetch.summary: TERMINAL ONLINE banner over two bordered panels
fastfetch.description: A bold TERMINAL ONLINE banner of colored sparkles tops two bordered panels beside the Arch logo - one for OS and desktop, one for CPU, GPU and memory - with a magenta user@host title between them and a circle color bar below. Red keys lead, joined by green, yellow, blue and magenta sections.

fastfetch.name: Wide Card
fastfetch.author: kuruma-config
fastfetch.summary: Two stacked blue rounded boxes, identity and hardware
fastfetch.description: Two stacked rounded blue boxes beside the built-in Arch logo: an identity box (user, OS, kernel, DE, WM, packages) above a hardware box (memory, disk, swap, CPU, GPU, chassis, battery), with values trailing each closed label column. Blue primary accent on a near-black surface.
